meta.name: add-clidash
meta.description: Add clidash — a zero-dependency, read-only web dashboard that derives its tabs and tables at runtime from any CLI that lists resources as JSON. Ships pre-wired for NanoClaw's ncl CLI (agent groups, sessions, channels, users, roles), plus message-activity charts, a log tail, and a read-only file viewer for group skills/CLAUDE.md/profiles.

copy.tagline: 将任意 JSON 输出 CLI 转为实时 Web 仪表盘
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有输出 JSON 的 CLI 工具，想快速生成 Web 仪表盘
copy.tagline_en: Turn any JSON-output CLI into a live web dashboard
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a CLI that outputs JSON and want a quick web dashboard

howto.what: Claude 会照步骤安装并启动 clidash：一个只读网页看板（默认 http://127.0.0.1:4690）。标签页和表格按命令行输出自动生成；默认接好 NanoClaw 的 ncl，并含代理状态、活动图、日志尾、文件查看。
howto.when: 当你想装 clidash 这个只读看板（直接说“/add-clidash”也行），或想把某个命令行工具列出的资源变成网页表格时，就会触发安装流程。

say.text: 请用 /add-clidash 给项目加一个只读网页看板。
say.note: 会复制工具、生成配置并启动服务。

say.text: 把 docker 也接进来，在标签页里列出它的资源。
say.note: 在配置中加一个 CLI，不用改代码。

say.text: 面板只允许本机访问，不要绑到公网接口。
say.note: 保持 BIND=127.0.0.1 或私网地址。

howto.what_en: Adds clidash: a read-only local web dashboard on http://127.0.0.1:4690. It creates tabs/tables at runtime from any CLI's JSON list and is pre-wired for NanoClaw's `ncl`, with agent status, activity charts, log tail, and read-only file viewer.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say “/add-clidash”, ask to add the dashboard, or want a CLI's listed resources shown as web tables.

say_en.text: Please use /add-clidash to add a read-only web dashboard to this project.
say_en.note: It copies the tool, creates config, and starts the server.

say_en.text: Also wire up docker so its resources show in a tab.
say_en.note: Adds a CLI to the config; no code changes.

say_en.text: Keep the dashboard local-only and don't bind it to a public interface.
say_en.note: Stays on 127.0.0.1 or a private address.
